{"ascii":"Durable Records and Publication
|-- Shared repository facade: DiagramStore
|   |-- storeRoot = checkoutRoot / .diagrams (default)
|   |-- repositories -> GitRepositoryRegistry
|   |-- diagramPersistence -> DiagramPersistence -> DiagramRevisionStore
|   |   |-- SHA-256(JSON) identifies immutable records; reads verify the hash
|   |   |-- diagram / revision / history -> diagrams/<kind>/<hash>.json
|   |   `-- workspace -> workspace-records/<hash>.json [A]
|   `-- canvases = projectCatalogs -> same ProjectCatalogStore instance
|       |-- inherits CanvasCatalogStore: composition and publication
|       `-- adds corpus/compactions.json
|-- Editable workspace: MappingWorkspaceService -> WorkspaceRecordStore
|   |-- Record model: workspaceRecords.ts
|   |   |-- workspace -> projectId, documentIds, activeDocumentId, transfers
|   |   `-- document/<encoded ID>/
|   |       |-- metadata + saved baseline + current canvas + optional viewport
|   |       |-- history -> navigation/header data + checkpointHead record map
|   |       |-- checkpoint/<ID> -> snapshot or bounded delta
|   |       |-- revision/<ID> -> diagram revision
|   |       `-- item/<hash> -> shared canvas value or text
|   |           |-- split independently edited document/view objects
|   |           |-- extract sourceAscii and strings of length >= 512
|   |           `-- deduplicate by SHA-256; retain ordering in parent skeletons
|   |-- Checkpoint encoding: CanvasCheckpointEncoder
|   |   |-- delta = added / updated / removed record references
|   |   |-- parent available with depth < 31 -> delta against parent
|   |   `-- otherwise -> full record map at depth 0
|   |-- apply({requestId, expectedRevision, changes})
|   |   |-- serialize operations through an in-process queue per storage root
|   |   |-- check durable receipt BEFORE checking expectedRevision
|   |   |   |-- same requestId + same batch hash -> return recorded revision
|   |   |   `-- same requestId + different batch -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   |-- expectedRevision differs from manifest -> VERSION_CONFLICT
|   |   |-- stage changes and validate records, history and transfer references
|   |   |   |-- existing revisions/items cannot change content
|   |   |   `-- checkpoints may be re-encoded; semantic content stays immutable
|   |   `-- publish revision + 1
|   |       |-- 1. Write content-addressed blobs [A]
|   |       |   |-- workspace-records/<SHA-256(JSON)>.json
|   |       |   |-- reuse matching bytes; reject integrity mismatch
|   |       |   `-- at most 8 writers; await every writer, including on failure
|   |       |-- 2. Make blob writes durable
|   |       |   `-- temp file -> file fsync -> rename; then fsync blob directory
|   |       |-- 3. Atomically replace workspace-records.json
|   |       |   |-- schemaVersion + projectId + revision
|   |       |   |-- logical record key -> blob hash
|   |       |   |-- requestId -> {batch hash, committed revision}
|   |       |   `-- temp file -> file fsync -> rename -> parent directory fsync
|   |       `-- Failure handling
|   |           |-- before manifest replacement -> new blobs remain unreachable
|   |           `-- replacement may succeed before a later error/response loss
|   |               `-- retry SAME requestId to discover the committed receipt
|   `-- Initialization / replacement
|       |-- state(): absent manifest -> migrate legacy snapshot, revision 0
|       `-- replace(): existing manifest -> full record replacement, revision + 1
|-- Published catalog: MappingDiagramService -> CanvasCatalogStore
|   |-- publishCheckpoint(input): pin an already persisted workspace checkpoint
|   |   |-- require project, publication support and checkpoint capture service
|   |   |-- serialize catalog operation; read stored catalog without expansion
|   |   |-- check checkpointReceipts[requestId]
|   |   |   |-- identical input signature -> return prior receipt
|   |   |   `-- different signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   |-- updating an existing representation
|   |   |   `-- require settled status + expectedRevisionId; preserve ownership
|   |   |-- WorkspaceRecordStore.capture(documentId, checkpointId, expectedVersion)
|   |   |   |-- read ONE manifest to pin immutable references [A]
|   |   |   |-- require history.headId == checkpointId and metadata.version == expectedVersion
|   |   |   |-- hydrate selected checkpoint + only its referenced diagram revisions
|   |   |   `-- retain header and references to checkpoint/revision/item archive
|   |   |       `-- {$diagramRecord: 'workspace', id: blob hash} -> [A]
|   |   |-- derive publication document from captured head; validate repository
|   |   |-- set new catalog revision content to captured stored references
|   |   `-- atomically replace canvases/catalog.json
|   |       |-- representation head + revision references + retry receipt together
|   |       |-- receipt: representation, revisionId, savedVersion, checkpointId
|   |       `-- old catalog revisions and unrelated checkpoint bodies stay unexpanded
|   |-- Other catalog saves
|   |   |-- saveMappingDiagram(): generated key can reuse a prior publication
|   |   |-- saveProjectedTree(): generated tree and relationship in one catalog write
|   |   |-- publishOutputPromotion(): group, remapped canvases and receipt together
|   |   |-- acceptCanvasChanges(): all accepted heads and acceptance receipt together
|   |   `-- saveRepresentationCatalog()
|   |       `-- await DiagramPersistence.persist(catalog) -> atomic catalog replacement
|   |           `-- immutable records finish writing before references become visible
|   `-- archiveRepresentation(): change catalog metadata; retain encoded history refs
`-- Read and portability boundaries
    |-- Workspace reads
    |   |-- verify manifest project/version and blob hashes; validate referenced records
    |   |-- viewHeaders(): read index + metadata + history headers only
    |   `-- loadCanvasCheckpoint(): read selected state
    |       |-- checkpointHead supplied -> use its direct record map
    |       `-- otherwise -> bounded delta replay; verify loaded item hashes
    |-- Catalog reads
    |   |-- canvases/catalog.json; fallback to legacy representations/catalog.json
    |   |-- loadCurrentRepresentationCatalog(): restore selected/current revisions
    |   `-- loadRepresentationCatalog(): restore catalog with requested history validation
    `-- MappingWorkspaceService import/export
        |-- portableExport(): expand diagram-context disk refs into portable snapshots
        `-- prepareImport(): store context files before workspace can publish their refs"}
